scenario: Integer literal at INT64_MAX boundary (2^63 - 1 = 9223372036854775807) compiles per LGRA.2.7.3. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not read the value carried into the artefact.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v < 9223372036854775807
->
    log info "x"
